data.name: Club Security Simulator
data.detailed_description:
CHAOS IS AT THE DOOR. YOU HAVE THE KEY.

Club Security Simulator plunges you into the adrenaline and tension of neon-lit urban nights. You're not just a bouncer: you're the judge, the jury, and, if necessary, the executioner at the entrance to the city's most exclusive club.

AN EMERGENT BEHAVIOR SYSTEM

Every customer is unique. Thanks to a procedural statistics system, each individual in line has their own level aggression and patience.

  • The Butterfly Effect : Your actions alter the ecosystem in real time. Turn a customer away too abruptly, and the tension in the queue rises. Strike a troublemaker, and the crowd might turn against you. Learn to command respect… or prepare for a confrontation.

EVERY NIGHT IS A NEW RUN

The game features a roguelike structure where each night presents a unique challenge.

  • Survive until dawn : Manage increasingly difficult waves of clients as the hours pass.

  • Tactical Adaptation : Find and equip rare items during your shift (tactical walkie-talkie, reinforced gloves, energy drinks) to modify your playstyle and survive the craziest nights.

PROGRESSION AND EVOLUTION

Failure is just a step.

  • Meta Progression : Accumulate experience at the end of each shift to unlock permanent skills. Improve your physique, observation skills, or charisma to become a security legend.

  • Beome Indispensable : The further you progress, the more prestigious—and dangerous—the clubs you protect become.

KEY FEATURES

  • Tactical Simulation Gameplay : A unique blend of crowd management and third-person combat.

  • Unpredictable IA : Clients with dynamic behaviors influenced by your decisions.

  • Synthwave / Low-Poly Atmosphere : Total immersion in a striking neon-black aesthetic.

  • Addictive Gameplay Loop : Fast-paced, intense runs with deep progression.

The rope is taut. The music hits hard. It's up to you to decide who enters.

data.short_description: Take on the role of a bouncer and survive chaotic nights in this roguelike. Manage an unpredictable crowd, detect threats, and decide who gets the noose. Your choices dictate the club's atmosphere... or trigger a riot.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 3GHz 4-Core or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 or Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 3.5GHz 6-Core or similar
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3060 or Radeon RX 6700
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
